oral_examination.oral_examination: 47 Deep caries and pulp on the distal proximal surface, painful on probing; dull on cold examination; no obvious loosening; painful percussion ( ); loosening 1-2 degrees, no other obvious abnormality.

diagnosis.primary: 47 Chronic Pulpitis (K04.002) Treatment Plan 47 Root Canal Treatment. The patient signed the informed consent.

treatment_plan.notes: Instructions for follow-up consultation for discomfort include chewing a cotton roll for 40 minutes and not brushing teeth and gargling for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: 4% articaine 1.7mlX1 local infiltration anesthesia. Apply rubber dam, remove decay, open the pulp, uncover the top of the pulp, explore the two root canal orifices, extract the pulp; dredge the root canal, 15
